value.rationale: The number of distinct rough-set approximation pairs is a natural invariant of quasiorder-based information structures. Its exact identification on all graph-incidence orders with a standard Tutte evaluation transfers nontrivial combinatorial recurrences and reveals the genuinely different planar-polynomial versus general-#P-complete exact-counting behavior. The theorem covers every finite graph and arbitrary height-two neighborhood systems, not an ad hoc finite instance or a recomputation of a known table. It does not claim novelty of the classical Tutte/Potts or complexity machinery.
